baseline_models.focus_anchor: The counterfactual binds the value term at word 8 to being preceded at word 10 across the two named groups.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speakers make their own expected priority an admission test for value: a benefit that reached believers before them is treated as disqualified. Reception is therefore organized as a social race in which rank is presumed to control truth-access.

activation_trace.role: Contributes desirable benefit or advantage and supplies the value whose validity the speakers make socially conditional.
Contributes moving ahead in a contest or undertaking and converts reception into a ranking race.

changed_reading.before: The speakers deny that the message is good because believers accepted it first.
changed_reading.after: The utterance exposes an elite admission rule: value is certified by expected adopters and arrival order, so another group's precedence becomes a veto.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence moves from their failure to attain guidance by the object to their predictable future verdict on that same object.
baseline_models.mechanism: A failed relation is converted into an intrinsic defect: because the speakers do not arrive by means of it, they infer that it is displaced from truth. The falsehood label thus performs the very reversal it alleges, moving the explanatory burden from receiver to message and sealing the failure against correction.

activation_trace.role: Contributes gentle direction toward a true path and makes successful orientation the relation that has failed.
Contributes turning something away from its proper direction and functions as the speakers' causal inversion.
Contributes a lie displaced from truth and supplies the explicit content of the verdict.
Contributes a saying that circulates socially and turns private nonreception into a repeatable public account.
Contributes age from an earlier time and lets chronology harden the public verdict.

changed_reading.before: They fail to accept the message and consequently call it an old lie.
changed_reading.after: Their own non-arrival is made the premise of a self-protecting verdict: relational failure is reversed into alleged corruption of the guide.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same verse joins another group's earlier arrival with the message's own age.
baseline_models.mechanism: Two temporal valuations collide. Priority is presumed valuable when the speakers imagine possessing it, becomes disqualifying when believers possess it, and becomes another disqualification when attributed to the message as age. The accusation manages a defeated claim to precedence rather than applying a stable rule about time.

activation_trace.role: Contributes prior advance and supplies the first temporal axis, the believers' earlier arrival.
Contributes prior standing or credit and allows age to carry a status-valence rather than chronology alone.
Contributes temporal oldness and supplies the second axis, the message's relation to an earlier time.

changed_reading.before: Ancient falsehood simply means a lie inherited from long ago.
changed_reading.after: The adjective closes a temporal knot: the speakers resent being late yet also weaponize the message's earliness, revealing that priority changes value with its owner.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root of saying occurs at words 1 and 16, framing a present claim and a forecast future claim.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first utterance installs a criterion, and the future utterance protects it after nonreception. Speech is not merely reported twice; it is a production loop in which a social maxim generates a doctrinal label, making the response predictable before further evidence arrives.

activation_trace.role: Contributes articulated speech and marks the two overt outputs of the loop.
Contributes speech as a held position and makes the repeated utterances outputs of an underlying doctrine of rank.
Contributes the final falsehood category into which the loop deposits the message.

changed_reading.before: The verse records two separate hostile remarks.
changed_reading.after: It reconstructs a predictable speech machine: a status premise, failed uptake, and a reusable falsehood label are successive outputs of one closed position.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The speaking and addressed groups are identified by the focus roots for disbelief and belief before their argument is quoted.
baseline_models.mechanism: The group labels also stage opposed epistemic postures. Covering and blocking truth stand over against settled trust and assent; the speakers then project displacement from truth onto the object trusted by the other group. The accusation is therefore relational boundary-work, not a neutral quality assessment.

activation_trace.role: Contributes covering and supplies an active posture of obscuring rather than a merely demographic label.
Contributes blockage of acknowledged truth and locates a possible obstacle in the judging group.
Contributes settled security and trust and supplies the contrasting receptive posture.
Contributes assent in which the heart comes to rest and marks the uptake the speakers devalue.

changed_reading.before: Disbelievers and believers are labels for the two sides of an argument.
changed_reading.after: The labels enact the argument's epistemic asymmetry: an obscuring posture judges a trusting posture and transfers its own displacement onto the trusted object.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding scene supplies an informed witness to an analogous object, the witness's belief, and the audience's self-exaltation. The focus complaint about being preceded then reads as damage-control for rank: independent earlier uptake is potentially corroborative evidence, but is recoded as a defect because the wrong person arrived first.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the disputed benefit whose value is being filtered through social standing.
Supplies earlier arrival and receives a new role as corroboration that the speakers defensively invert.
Contributes testimony grounded in knowledge and makes the prior believer an evidentiary actor rather than merely an early adopter.
Contributes an analogous counterpart and links the witness's knowledge to the kind of object disputed in the focus.
Contributes settled assent and realizes the prior uptake that the focus speakers resent.
Contributes elevated rank and leadership and identifies prestige as the pressure behind rejection of the witness.

structural_cues: 46:10 immediately precedes the focus and orders knowledgeable testimony, belief, and self-exaltation before 46:11 turns earlier belief into a negative test.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the adjacent witness, analogous object, belief, and self-exaltation; I infer that the precedence complaint protects rank against that scene. A live alternative is that 46:11 targets a general class prejudice rather than this witness in particular.

changed_reading.before: The speakers take earlier belief by others as evidence that the message lacks value.
changed_reading.after: Earlier belief has just appeared as informed corroboration; their counterfactual is a prestige-defense that reverses unwelcome evidence because its bearer outranks their permission structure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding sequence refuses novelty as a requirement, places an earlier book before the present one, and later describes a book after Moses as confirming what precedes it and guiding to truth. Age can therefore carry continuity, comparison, and confirmation. The focus adjective does not neutrally expose a stale source; it polemically reverses a potentially validating genealogy.

activation_trace.role: Contributes temporal oldness and supplies the feature whose evidentiary valence the context reverses.
Contributes origination without precedent and explicitly denies that unprecedented novelty is the messenger's claim.
Contributes temporal advance and places an earlier witness in a positive documentary chain.
Contributes an ordered written corpus and materially joins the earlier and present attestations.
Contributes soundness and settled validity and makes relation to the earlier book confirmatory rather than contaminating.
Contributes the later audience's recognition of the message as an ordered book within the same chain.
Contributes confirming soundness and makes backward relation an active test of validity.
Contributes direction to truth and shows that continuity and guidance coexist in the object called old in the focus.

structural_cues: 46:9 denies unprecedented novelty, 46:12 places an earlier book before the present book, and 46:30 calls a post-Mosaic book confirmatory of what precedes it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit precedence, book-relations, confirmation, and guidance; I infer that historical continuity is an alternative positive reading of age. The live alternative is that the focus adjective attacks only a recurrent lie and does not deny all precedent.

changed_reading.before: Calling the message ancient marks its age as evidence of falsehood.
changed_reading.after: The insult selectively flips a documented continuity: what can function as precedent and mutual confirmation is redescribed as stale fabrication.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier in the discourse the speakers are challenged to produce a prior book or surviving trace grounded in knowledge as proof of truth. The focus later dismisses the message through its age. Read together, antiquity is not an intrinsically invalid category; prior material is demanded when it might support the speakers and degraded when it supports the message.

activation_trace.role: Contributes relation to earlier time and becomes the selectively devalued property.
Contributes the falsehood verdict attached to age and supplies the negative half of the double standard.
Contributes prior temporal position and makes earlier evidence explicitly admissible in the challenge.
Contributes a surviving mark that indicates what once was and supplies durable evidence from the past.
Contributes disclosed knowledge and specifies the epistemic quality required of the prior trace.
Contributes settled soundness and makes the requested past evidence a proposed truth test.

structural_cues: 46:4's evidentiary imperative precedes the focus, although its immediate object is the speakers' rival cult claims rather than the message itself.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a demand for prior knowledgeable evidence and a later age-based dismissal; I transfer the discourse's stated evidence rule across the two claims. A material alternative is that the rule is domain-specific, so the contrast need not be hypocrisy.

changed_reading.before: Ancient falsehood is an independent insult about the message's age.
changed_reading.after: It participates in selective antiquity: the past is welcomed as proof for inherited commitments but renamed falsehood when its traces challenge them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Manifest signs are called deceptive magic, the message is next called fabricated, the focus calls it old falsehood, and a later speaker calls the promise old tales. The labels move while rejection remains fixed. Their variation makes each label look like a substitutable defense generated after the stance rather than a stable diagnosis generated by evidence.

activation_trace.role: Contributes socially circulating speech and carries the focus label into a wider sequence of public formulas.
Contributes the focus falsehood label as one member of the mobile taxonomy.
Contributes manifest disclosure and supplies the evidentiary clarity that the first hostile label bypasses.
Contributes deceptive diversion and supplies the first replacement category for what has appeared clearly.
Contributes invented lying and supplies the next alternative label without changing the prior rejection.
Contributes false old tales and extends the same defensive taxonomy into a later generational dispute.

structural_cues: The accusation sequence at 46:7, 46:8, 46:11, and 46:17 changes predicates while preserving rejection and repeatedly uses a deictic target.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distinct labels under a stable rejecting posture; I infer substitution because the categories change faster than the stance. A live alternative is that each label names a genuinely distinct objection rather than rhetorical mobility.

changed_reading.before: Old falsehood is the speakers' particular assessment of the message.
changed_reading.after: It is one interchangeable output in a mobile labeling practice whose fixed input is rejection, so lexical variety masks epistemic closure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later address to the same rejecting group describes wholesome goods as already carried away in worldly life, enjoyed, and joined to self-exaltation. That materializes the focus criterion: the speakers may hear good as scarce, appropriable advantage whose value depends on reaching their group first. Their problem is not only a wrong answer about the message but a consumer-status model of value.

activation_trace.role: Contributes desirable benefit and receives a narrowed, socially appropriable sense from the later consumption scene.
Contributes passing away and makes worldly advantages benefits that can be used up and gone.
Contributes what is wholesome rather than corrupt and supplies the later category of valued goods.
Contributes pleasurable utility and turns value into immediate consumable enjoyment.
Contributes elevated rank and joins consumed advantage to the prestige logic already active in the focus.

structural_cues: 46:20 returns to the rejecting group and sequences exhausted worldly goods, enjoyment, and self-exaltation before judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies later valued consumables and rank; I infer that this scene exposes the value-model behind the focus counterfactual. A live alternative is that the focus value term means truth or revelation without any consumer sense.

changed_reading.before: The speakers make a mistaken abstract judgment about whether revelation is good.
changed_reading.after: Their test treats good as a scarce status-benefit that should accrue to them first; the later scene exposes how such goods can be consumed while enduring value is missed.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later audience is directed toward the recitation, listens with comprehension, calls for attentive silence, hears it through, recognizes guidance, and invites assent. This supplies the missing middle hidden by the focus speakers' inference. Guidance is encountered through an oriented reception process; failure at that process cannot by itself establish a defect in the guide.

activation_trace.role: Contributes direction toward path and truth and names the relation whose failed realization is under dispute.
Contributes redirection toward a face or destination and initiates the receptive trajectory.
Contributes understanding and responsive compliance, making listening more than acoustic exposure.
Contributes recitation and supplies the articulated object around which the listening process forms.
Contributes attentive silence and supplies a deliberate condition for reception.
Contributes recognized direction to truth and realizes what the focus speakers claim not to have found.
Contributes settled assent and marks the trajectory's invited response rather than a property forced by exposure.

structural_cues: 46:29-31 orders redirection, listening, silence, completion, communal report, recognized guidance, and invited assent; 46:10 separately links non-guidance with injustice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered listener process; I infer that receptive orientation mediates the guide's effect and that the focus suppresses this mediation. A live alternative is that guidance is primarily a divine grant, with listening as consequence rather than cause.

changed_reading.before: The speakers did not obtain guidance from the message, so they judged it false.
changed_reading.after: Their premise omits a reception trajectory that another audience enacts; non-guidance diagnoses a blocked relation at least as plausibly as a defective message.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier people accuse a messenger of turning them away from inherited gods. Later those very helpers fail to aid, disappear from their users, and the support-system is named falsehood and fabrication. The focus accusation therefore participates in a reversible struggle over direction: the message is called the displacement, while the inherited apparatus that promised support is ultimately identified as displaced from truth.

activation_trace.role: Contributes turning away from a direction and supplies the focus speakers' accusation against the message.
Contributes attempted redirection from inherited objects and reveals what the hostile accusation protects.
Contributes aid that should make a protected relation effective and supplies the practical promise that fails.
Contributes loss of the supposed helpers and makes the support-system vanish under practical test.
Contributes falsehood displaced from truth and redirects the focus category onto the speakers' own apparatus.
Contributes invented lying and identifies fabrication as the process sustaining the failed helpers.

structural_cues: 46:22 directs the displacement accusation at the messenger, whereas 46:28 narratively assigns falsehood to the inherited helpers after their failure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated displacement language, protected inherited objects, failed aid, loss, and fabrication; I infer a projection-like reversal in 46:11. A live alternative is that the repeated vocabulary is polemical symmetry without a psychological projection claim.

changed_reading.before: The speakers call the revelation an old lie that diverts people from truth.
changed_reading.after: Their label protects an inherited support-system and mirrors its own failure: what they call diversion is reorientation away from helpers whose promised aid disappears.

context_deltas.mechanism: A destroyed predecessor community is described as more established than the present audience and as equipped with faculties that nevertheless did not benefit it. Material priority and capacity thus fail as certificates of discernment. The focus speakers' assumption that their group should have arrived first if the message were valuable belongs to the same unreliable status metric.

activation_trace.role: Contributes relative advancement and supplies the social priority claim tested by the predecessor comparison.
Contributes desirable benefit and supplies what superior capacity is wrongly expected to identify first.
Contributes effective empowerment and makes the earlier community materially superior to the current speakers.
Contributes understanding and compliance and highlights that an available faculty can remain practically unprofitable.

structural_cues: 46:26 explicitly compares the predecessor community's greater establishment with the current audience, then lists hearing, sight, and hearts that availed nothing amid denial.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies comparative empowerment and failed faculties; I infer that this undercuts the focus group's expectation of epistemic firstness. A live alternative is that material power and social precedence are separate metrics with only analogical force.

changed_reading.before: The speakers assume their standing would make them first to recognize anything truly valuable.
changed_reading.after: The historical comparison denies that capacity, establishment, or prior rank guarantees discernment; greater resources can coexist with a reception failure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Soon after the focus, another saying is followed by sustained uprightness. That sequence contrasts with the focus sequence, where failed orientation is followed by another label. Speech is thereby tested by the trajectory it inaugurates: one utterance stabilizes conduct, while the other stabilizes avoidance.

activation_trace.role: Contributes speech as a held position and supplies the hostile position whose practical trajectory is examined.
Contributes an affair's direction, course, and conduct and links verbal position to subsequent orientation.
Contributes speech as conviction and supplies the contrasting utterance that is carried into action.
Contributes upright balance and makes stable conduct the test of the preceding saying.

structural_cues: The focus orders failed orientation then future saying, while 46:13 orders saying then continued uprightness through an explicit subsequent link.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two saying-to-trajectory sequences; I infer that their contrast evaluates speech by what it organizes afterward. A live alternative is that the passages describe unrelated groups without inviting a formal comparison.

changed_reading.before: The focus saying is wrong because its proposition is false.
changed_reading.after: Its deeper failure is performative: unlike committed speech that opens into upright conduct, it follows blocked orientation and organizes continued evasion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries an atmospheric reversal into an epistemic clause; it remains anchored by the focus deictic verdict, speech, and directional inversion while 46:24 stages confident misnaming under desire. Downstream prose should present it only as an illuminating analogy, not equate the message with the destructive storm.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus speakers point to the message, say what it is, and classify it through a root of directional inversion.

activation_trace.role: Contributes a thing's apparent indication as a kind of saying and makes deictic classification an interpretive act.
Contributes reversal from proper direction and identifies the focus classification as potentially inverted.
Contributes an overt spoken classification and supplies the material scene's confident verbal verdict.
Contributes something appearing from a direction and supplies the visible form that is too quickly interpreted.
Contributes rain descending from cloud and supplies the desired benefit projected onto the appearance.
Contributes wind and supplies the materially different reality concealed by the desired classification.

changed_reading.before: The demonstrative introduces a straightforward hostile name for the message.
changed_reading.after: The demonstrative can mark a desire-driven perception event: like the visible cloud called welcome rain, the message is confidently named through the speakers' need before its reality is received.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because no literal wager is stated; it remains anchored in the explicit race-like precedence and disputed good. Downstream prose should call it a social-rivalry resonance, not claim that the verse describes an actual contest or stake.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus counterfactual makes the value of the good depend on which group has won temporal precedence.

activation_trace.role: Contributes the stake or prize attached to a race and recasts disputed good as value allocated by winning first place.
Contributes desirable benefit and supplies the prize-like value devalued once another group reaches it first.

changed_reading.before: Earlier adoption is used as an abstract argument against value.
changed_reading.after: The speakers behave as though truth were a wagered prize: once believers occupy first place, they protect status by declaring the prize worthless.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a form-distant split-root activation, not a claim about the ordinary morphology of saying; it remains worth carrying because the packet supplies the mapping and the surrounding verdicts visibly oscillate among magic, fabrication, and old falsehood. Downstream prose should mark it as branch resonance only.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The doubled focus occurrence of saying frames a verdict that belongs to a visibly changing series of hostile classifications.

activation_trace.role: The split mapping contributes movement and lack of fixed position and recasts the doubled saying as unstable judgment.
The same instability resonance marks the magic verdict as one temporary position in the hostile taxonomy.
The repeated saying with a fabrication verdict supplies the visible movement from one classification to another.

changed_reading.before: The speakers consistently diagnose the message as false through several equivalent terms.
changed_reading.after: A split-root resonance foregrounds classificatory wobble: repeated saying keeps moving because no hostile label achieves a stable account of the object.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant split mapping for the guidance root; it remains anchored in the explicit move from failed guidance to a future verbal verdict and is reinforced by the saying-as-conjecture branch. Downstream prose should describe an epistemic resonance, not derive the focus verb from the split root.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus moves directly from not attaining guidance to a forecast accusation without an intervening evidentiary test.

activation_trace.role: The split mapping contributes a suspicion pictured inwardly without settled verification and highlights what replaces attained direction.
Contributes saying that functions like conjecture and gives the unverified inward picture an overt future form.
Contributes impaired or misdirected judgment and relocates possible defect from the message to the appraisal.

changed_reading.before: The speakers reach a firm falsehood judgment after failing to find guidance.
changed_reading.after: The future verdict may expose an unstabilized suspicion masquerading as settled knowledge: conjectural speech fills the space where orientation failed.

strongest_changes: 46:10 turns another person's precedence from a supposed defeater into informed corroboration that the speakers reverse to protect rank.
46:9, 46:12, and 46:30 convert age from contamination into a chain of precedent, confirmation, and guidance.
46:22 and 46:28 reverse the falsehood accusation onto the inherited support-system whose promised aid disappears.
46:29-31 reconstruct guidance as an oriented listener trajectory, exposing the missing mediation in the focus speakers' self-sealing inference.
summary.what_was_special: The focus compresses a social race, a causal reversal, two incompatible uses of priority, and a predicted speech loop into one argument. The context repeatedly reruns those mechanisms with witnesses, books, consumed goods, failed helpers, and attentive nonhuman listeners, allowing several changed readings to coexist without selecting one.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact social referent of those who preceded remains open, so the 46:10 witness link is strong by adjacency but not forced.
The prior-evidence challenge in 46:4 concerns rival cult claims, so transferring its standard to the message remains abductive.
The material benefit scene in 46:20 may expose the focus speakers' value-model, but the focus value term can still denote truth or revelation without consumer coloring.
The non-dominant mappings for saying and guidance are deliberately retained as resonances and must not be presented as ordinary derivations.
